changelog.change: Configure native entity descriptions and linked event evidence.

person.description: Names of specific individual people. Exclude generic groups, occupations, standalone job titles, pronouns, organizations and publications.

organization.description: Names of specific organizations, including companies, institutions and publications.

location.description: Names of specific geographic places, including cities, regions and countries.

fields.name: action
fields.description: The verbatim action or event trigger for this candidate.

fields.name: actors
fields.description: Participants performing the action, not those affected.

fields.name: objects
fields.description: Participants or things affected by the action.

fields.name: times
fields.description: Time expressions belonging to this event, not unrelated dates or publication metadata.

fields.name: places
fields.description: Locations belonging to this event, not unrelated places or datelines.
